sacraments.text: Book church and finalise arrangements/contributions at least six months ahead. Attend EE or MPC. Arrange priest interview normally at least one month ahead. Provide both parties’ birth certificates/NRIC or passports, baptism extracts issued within six months, two witnesses’ details, ROM notice/certificate and EE/MPC certificate; additional documents for previous marriage/divorce/death of spouse if applicable. Coordinate music/rehearsal and hall reception through secretary. Website’s Lenten date wording is erroneous; confirm blackout dates.

Begins Level 1 at age 7; First Reconciliation Level 2, First Communion Level 3; Confirmation journey Levels 7–11. Primary sessions Saturday/Sunday 14:00–15:30; Levels 7/8 Saturday same time, Level 9 Saturday/Sunday same time, Levels 10/11 timetable-specific. 2027 registration link mycatholic.sg/catch on updates page.

Weekly Wednesdays 20:00–22:00 in Parish Hall. Welcomes inquirers, baptised Catholics seeking Confirmation, and practising Catholic sponsors. Dedicated contact uses catholic.org.sg; introductory paragraph also lists Gmail.
Download registration form; submit completed form and relevant documents to office at least two weeks before preparation session.
Check priest/church availability with office before making any other arrangements. Deceased parishioners should have funeral rites in their parish.
Contact Catherine Lee via ministry email.

Usually first Sunday of odd-numbered months at 16:00 in Church. Parents/godparents compulsory preparation two weeks before baptism, Thursday 20:00 St Michael’s Room L2. Submit downloaded form to Parish Secretary at least two weeks before baptism. Up to 2 godparents, ordinarily 16+, confirmed practising Catholics with First Eucharist; not child’s parents. Page permits a baptised non-Catholic Christian witness in pastoral circumstances, not recorded as official godparent.
